name: Grilled Eggplant Sandwich with Tomato, Goat Cheese & Rosemary Potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium yellow potatoes
½ eggplant
2 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Slice potatoes into thin wedges and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the potatoes, along with oil, rosemary, and salt; toss to combine and spread out in a single layer on the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
extra virgin olive oil
salt

instructions.primary_message: Place potatoes in the oven and bake, tossing once, until tender and golden, 25-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, halve, and cut eggplant into ¼-inch-thick slices. Transfer to the bowl used for the potatoes.
Add oil, vinegar, and salt to the bowl; toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp balsamic vinegar
salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, add eggplant and grill until tender, flipping once, 3-4 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, place goat cheese, oil, and Italian seasoning in a small bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (113 g) log goat cheese
extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: If desired, place buns, cut-side down, on the grill pan to toast, 1-2 minutes.
Spread buns evenly with goat cheese. Top the bottom halves with eggplant and tomato, closing with the top half of the bun.
To serve, divide sandwiches and potato wedges between plates. Enjoy!
